user.title: House Power Manager
user.description: Keeps grid import below the connection limit. Add the devices to manage afterwards with **Add managed device**.

data_description.grid_sensor: Power measured on the main connection (W, kW or MW). With PV this is import minus export, not house load.
data_description.sign_convention: How the sensor reports power drawn from the grid.
data_description.import_limit: Grid import at which the limiter cuts supply.
data_description.margin: Import is kept this far below the limit. Target = limit − margin.
data_description.hysteresis: A device is restored only when headroom exceeds its power by this much, so it isn't shed again straight away.
data_description.update_interval: Re-check this often even when the sensor does not change.
data_description.fault_timeout: Without a fresh reading for this long the sensor is treated as faulty.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: Sent to the notify targets below. Messages are also written to the log.

data.notify_shed: Device switched off because of overload

data_description.notify_targets: A notify action such as mobile_app_my_phone, or a notify entity such as notify.family.
data_description.notify_shed: When import goes over the target or the limit and devices are switched off.
data_description.notify_limit: When import comes within the warning margin of the limit. Sent again only after import was back under the target.
data_description.warning_margin: Import above limit − this counts as close. At most the margin, so normal balancing doesn't trigger it.

error.unsupported_unit: The sensor must report power in W, kW or MW.
error.margin_too_large: The margin must be smaller than the import limit.
error.unknown_notify: No notify action or notify entity with this name.
error.warning_below_target: The warning margin must not be larger than the margin.

user.title: Managed device
user.description: A load switched on and off by House Power Manager. Once added, turn on its **Requested** switch (or call `house_power_manager.request_power`) instead of switching the device directly.

data_description.priority: 1 is shed first. A device can take power from running devices with a lower number.
data_description.control_entity: The switch (or climate, water heater, fan, light) turned on when power is granted and off when it is shed.
data_description.nominal_power: Power drawn when running. Used to decide whether there is room to switch it on.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional. The device's real consumption, used instead of the nominal power when deciding what to shed.
data_description.supply_group: Optional. Devices with the same name here share one supply, such as the indoor units of one multi-split outdoor unit, and are switched off together. Pick a name already in use or type a new one.
data_description.min_on_time: Not shed sooner than this after being switched on, unless import exceeds the hard limit.
data_description.min_off_time: Not switched on again sooner than this after being switched off.
data_description.latency: How long until a command shows in the grid measurement. Use more for cloud devices.
